products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute is a non-profit government research laboratory founded in 2020, described on its own site as the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its website is built around the Falcon family of generative large language models, which the institute presents as an effort to make advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere.

Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E are described as the latest additions to the family. Falcon-H1 uses a hybrid architecture based on Transformer and Mamba, and the site says it outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen. Falcon Perception is a multimodal model that reads and understands images from natural language prompts. Falcon Arabic targets Modern Standard Arabic and dialects. Falcon H1R 7B is a 7B reasoning model for mathematics, coding, logic and instruction following. Falcon Mamba 7B is described as the first open source State Space Language Model. Earlier releases include Falcon 180B, with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, Falcon 40B, with 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, and Falcon 2 11B, which the site says outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. The institute also announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models, and AI71, launched by ATRC and VentureOne, issued a call for proposals for work with Falcon 10B.

The Falcon LLM is noted as UAE-hosted and open source under Apache 2.0, positioned around sovereign AI and Middle East data residency. No lawsuits involving the institute are noted.
